style: warm editorial, light paper, one marker accent
fallback_note: Planned as webpage capture of https://www.vsointernational.org/; the host is blocked by this environment's egress policy, so the piece degraded to asset-free kinetic type. Palette is not VSO brand palette.
brief: Type-only intro. One motif: words rise, then a marker sweeps under the one word that carries the line. Scenes 1-2 share the head 'People who' and swap the tail, so national and international volunteers read as one idea. Scene 3 names the method. Scene 4 is a plain VSO lockup and URL, held for ~1.4s.
